arena_road_desc: From the Meadows to the Ashlands: three rounds in each land, its champion in the third, and on to the next, as far as you can get.
arena_road_desc_more: You start in the plainest Meadows gear from a chest, with whatever weapon the armourer hands you, and keep it, building it up as you go: the fighters drop coins; between lands a reward chest holds a free upgrade, and the Armourer sells upgrades (or another kind of weapon), fresh food and meads. The crowd throws the rest when you please them, and the kitchen's meals are leftovers, so you will need them.

arena_daily_done: You have won it today: it pays as usual.
arena_daily_bonus: Win it and the prize is half as big again.
arena_champion_desc: One named champion, a head taller, with as many stars as it can bear. You fight with what you carry.
arena_endless_desc: Wave after wave, harder each time, until you fall or take your purse. You fight with what you carry.
arena_head_who_hint: each land opens as your world beats the boss before it
arena_head_stake_hint: paid double if you win · you have {0} coins
arena_prize_endless: Each wave adds to your purse (about {0} coins for the first, more after).
arena_prize_road: The fighters drop coins, more in each land and with the crowd's favour: spend them on upgrades, or walk out with them. Champions drop their trophy and the land's metal (in the lands your world has reached).
arena_prize_win: A win pays about {0}, more with the crowd's favour, and the champion's trophy.
arena_prize_win_mat: A win pays about {0} and {1}, more with the crowd's favour, and the champion's trophy.

arena_lent_note: <color=#ffd27a>The Arena Master holds everything you carry while you fight</color>, and gives it back when you come out (or when you rise again).
arena_death_lent: <color=#ff9a6a>Death is real in the ring:</color> fall and your purse is lost.
arena_death_own: <color=#ff9a6a>Death is real in the ring:</color> fall and your purse is lost and your tombstone waits in the forecourt.
arena_enter_hint: The grate in the tunnel beyond the main gate rises: walk through it into the ring and the fight begins.
arena_duel_desc: You both walk into the ring, are taken to your ends of it, and after a countdown fight with what you carry (PvP is switched on for you, and back off after). The first to drop to a fifth of their health loses; nobody dies in a duel. The winner takes both wagers, less a tenth to the arena. Leaving the ring forfeits.
